# sh-list-score

**Purpose:** Pictogram + name + points, e.g. Kundali koota scores. Not tappable (40 tall). Part of sh-list — place sh-list and pick its Type; edit these options under Row.

**State:** Default (points) · Locked (points behind a lock, greyed name).

Core · 2 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=3322-75527) (node `3322:75527`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### State=Default

sh-list · Score

**Purpose:** a scored item: pictogram, name and its value (e.g. koota points).

### State=Locked

sh-list · Score · Locked

**Purpose:** a score hidden until upgrade: muted name and a lock in place of the value.
